semantics.composition: Two instances each of A and B, all driven by x,y; z=(a1|b1)^(a2&b2)
semantics.latency: Combinational, no clock, reset, or stored state specified
semantics.initialization: No specified initial unknown requirement; output follows current inputs after combinational settling

numeric.width: All ports and intermediates unsigned single bits
numeric.arithmetic: Bitwise Boolean operators; no rounding or overflow

verification.oracle: Independent top truth table derived from original A equation, B waveform and gate composition: 00=1,01=0,10=1,11=1
verification.waveform: Replay all original 0 through 90 ns entries at exact timestamps, sample 1 ps after each to allow delta settling
verification.coverage: All binary input pairs and all ordered transitions, timeout and fatal mismatches
verification.evaluation: python3 dev_check.py --label initial; development verification only

specification_ambiguities: B is given as a waveform rather than an equation; repeated input values and all four binary combinations support the combinational XNOR interpretation. No clock or state mechanism is specified.
Behavior for X/Z inputs is not specified; RTL uses natural four-state bitwise operators, and verification covers defined binary inputs.
